title: The last four were found in May #DyatlovPass #shorts
subtitle: Dead Mountain · Short 4/6
caption:
On 4 May 1959, as the snow melted, searchers found the last four hikers in a ravine beyond the pine – some wearing clothing taken from friends who had died earlier, as if they had tried to keep each other alive.
